description:
VPN client with full VLESS transport support, AmneziaWG, subscription management, and system-level TUN mode


VeilBox 2.2.0
- Added Shadowsocks and Hysteria2 profile support, including subscription/URI import.
- Added TUN routing for selected executable processes and split routing by domain/IP/GeoIP/GeoSite.
- Added real-download speed balancing with automatic failover and Xray Routing API switching.
- Added GeoIP/GeoSite assets, country flags, updated Tauri dependencies, and Xray installation helper.
- Updated the application version to 2.2.0.
Windows installer
Download VeilBox_2.2.0_x64-setup.exe below and run it on Windows 10/11.
